mass.interpretation: Payload is cargo only. 25 kg is structural gross mass, never the payload rating.
mass.future_arm: Include any arm, gripper, battery, deck and electronics in the 10 kg base limit; re-evaluate CG and operating loads after installation.
mass.user_confirmation: Latest acceptance of normal cargo 10 kg, cargo 8 kg on 5 degrees, structural cargo 15 kg / factor 2.

load_placement.status: Design and acceptance limits, not measured CG values. Place and restrain the cargo by its CG, not merely by its footprint.
load_placement.change_control: Recalculate before operating outside any reviewed mass, CG, support, tire or acceleration limit.

drive.speed_note: The initial limits apply first. Later limits require the thermal, stopping and handling checks. Stall torque is not used for continuous sizing.

cases.purpose: slope design target, not operation release
static structural verification, not a 15 kg operating rating

strength.comparison_note: Entire 25 kg gross weight on one isolated mount is a conservative fixture design envelope, not a permissible motor wheel load or an impact qualification.

catalog_comparison_only.note: Catalog allowable loads are not yield loads and are not divided by the structural safety factor.

operation_release.initial_test_floor: Level, smooth indoor floor, contained test area, initially unloaded.
operation_release.step_crossing: No intentional step crossing; impact factor and tire compliance are unqualified.
operation_release.note: These are design limits. Payload 10/8 kg is released only after the linked hardware acceptance tests. No slope test before independent roll-away prevention.
